title: Function that counts elements larger than a bound
statement: Write a CountLarger function that takes an array of 5 integers by reference, its size and a bound, and returns how many elements are larger than the bound. Read 5 numbers and then the bound, and write the result of calling it.

assertions.name: CountLarger
assertions.requirement: The statement asks for a function named CountLarger with three parameters.
The statement asks you to solve it with an array.
